query:
SELECT ct.id AS "id!"
                    FROM (
                        SELECT id, team_id, company_id, hidden
                        FROM crm_contacts
                        WHERE id = COALESCE(
                              (SELECT a.contact_id FROM crm_contact_aliases a WHERE a.retired_id = $1),
                              $1
                          )
                        OFFSET 0
                    ) ct
                    LEFT JOIN crm_companies co ON co.id = ct.company_id
                    WHERE ct.team_id = $2
                      AND (NOT (ct.hidden OR co.hidden IS TRUE) OR $3)
